Messages.Author: Inovia Sil
Messages.Body:
The superior text of Derange suggests that while a vampire so Deranged
cannot untap as normal, it can untap multiple times in a single turn for
one blood each time you untap the vampire (like an unlimited Freak Drive).
I was about to build an abusive deck around this, but thought I should
ask if this is correct or not. The abusive combo uses Restoration to
refill every so many actions (ie. bleed/untap, bleed/untap,
Restoration/untap, ad infinitum). Please clarify, thanks in advance.

-Inovia Sil

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Inovia Sil wrote:
>
> The superior text of Derange suggests that while a vampire so Deranged
> cannot untap as normal, it can untap multiple times in a single turn for
> one blood each time you untap the vampire (like an unlimited Freak Drive).

It cannot. This is the errata/ruling (from the monthly posting):

Derange - action (dem):
cannot be moved to a Malkavian Antitribu vampire. [LSJ 970224]
superior should read: "As above, and the vampire with this card does not
untap as normal. He or she may burn 1 blood once during his controller's
untap phase to untap." [LSJ 970224]
